import 'dart:math';

List<int> parseNestedParens(String parenString) {
  final result = <int>[];
  int depth = 0;
  for (final char in parenString.split('')) {
    if (char == '(') {
      depth += 1;
    } else if (char == ')') {
      depth -= 1;
    }
    if (depth > 0 && depth % 2 == 1) {
      // Only push when the current depth is odd and positive, indicating a new level of nesting.
      result.add(depth);
    }
  }
  return result;
}
